intro: Four complete programs, each shown with the output it renders. Read the code as annotated steps, then copy the whole program into a console app.

items.title: Your first static chart
items.outcome: One chart definition saved as SVG, HTML and PNG.

items.title: Small-multiple report grid
items.outcome: Typed records faceted into one chart per site, in a single report image.

items.title: Organization hierarchy
items.outcome: One team tree that mixes standard, compact and vertical branches.

items.title: Interactive topology explorer
items.outcome: A searchable estate map you can drill into, in one HTML file.
